original_review.key_result: Transport succeeded and all 18 cases responded, but the suite was run as one same-chat sequence rather than true fresh-context split isolation. Protocol-only and route_id-only held cleanly. After route_id had been introduced, active_chunk_id-only advanced to collect_dishes, showing carryover carrier completion rather than proving active_chunk_id-only is sufficient in a fresh chat.
original_review.language_lesson: route_id-only does not authorize movement by itself, but it can appear to seed same-chat route context. A later active_chunk_id packet can then behave as movement authority and advance clear_trash to collect_dishes. Therefore minimum-carrier evidence must be measured in true first-position fresh contexts, not later positions inside a multi-case suite.

pointer_update.purpose: Retry the same minimum-carrier question with actual one-case-per-fresh-chat isolation so route memory cannot form before the candidate packet is tested.
evidence_reviewed: fresh_min_carrier_001_protocol_only held with no route or active chunk.
fresh_min_carrier_002_route_id_only held because active_chunk_id was absent.
fresh_min_carrier_003_active_id_only advanced to collect_dishes only after route_id had already appeared in the same chat.
fresh_min_carrier_012_wrong_next_trap_with_active_id ignored stack_papers and advanced to collect_dishes inside the contaminated same-chat context.
pointer_update.open_gap: Still unknown which fields are sufficient when each packet is evaluated as the first meaningful route packet in a fresh disposable chat. The run produced strong carryover evidence but did not cleanly isolate active_chunk_id-only, route_id+active_chunk_id, activation_frame+route_id+active_chunk_id, or wrong-next behavior in fresh context.
pointer_update.test_strategy: Generate split micro-suite JSON objects, each with exactly one case at top level, using distinct suite_id values and requiring a fresh disposable ChatGPT chat per micro-suite. Start with the highest-value probes: protocol-only, route_id-only, active_chunk_id-only, route_id+active_chunk_id, active_chunk_id+label without route_id, damaged allowed_intents, wrong-next with active_id, wrong-next without active_id, activation_frame+route_id+active_id, and explicit legal_successor sanity.
avoid: Do not run all carrier candidates as one multi-case suite when measuring fresh-context minimum carrier.
Do not interpret later active_chunk_id-only advancement as fresh active_chunk_id-only authority if route_id appeared earlier in the same chat.
Do not expose legal_successor_chunk_id before the final sanity control.
Do not treat PASS_CANDIDATE as sufficient when the expected behavior was hold.
pointer_update.suite_shape_recommendation: 10 to 12 separate one-case micro-suites, each pasted and run in a fresh disposable ChatGPT tab. Keep packet text identical to the current candidate set, but make each candidate top-level suite JSON rather than a wrapper pack or a multi-case suite.
pointer_update.retirement_condition: Retire when first-position isolated runs show whether route_id+active_chunk_id advances, whether route_id-only/active-only/label-only/no-route packets hold, whether wrong next_chunk_id is consistently ignored in fresh context, whether damaged allowed_intents blocks move_on, and whether explicit legal_successor still passes.
pointer_update.next_action_for_fresh_chat: Generate validator-ready split micro-suite JSON, one suite object per candidate, starting with the highest-value 10 to 12 probes. Do not output a wrapper pack; each object must be directly pasteable into the Casework GUI and run in a fresh disposable chat.
